description: This file defines the SubPanel class, which manages the behavior and rendering of subpanels in the SuiteCRM SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for loading subpanel definitions, generating search queries, rendering buttons and lists, and handling subpanel customization.

classes.name: SubPanel
classes.description: Class responsible for managing subpanel rendering, configuration, and interactions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SubPanel instance with module, record ID, subpanel ID, definitions, and collections.

methods.name: setTemplateFile
methods.description: Sets the template file used for rendering.

methods.name: setBeanList
methods.description: Assigns a list of beans to the subpanel.

methods.name: setHideNewButton
methods.description: Sets whether to hide the 'New' button.

methods.name: getHeaderText
methods.description: Placeholder for generating header text for the subpanel.

methods.name: get_buttons
methods.description: Generates HTML for action buttons in the subpanel.

methods.name: ProcessSubPanelListView
methods.description: Generates the list view of records within the subpanel, including query processing.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the subpanel list view or count.

methods.name: getModulesWithSubpanels
methods.description: Returns modules that contain subpanel definitions.

methods.name: getModuleSubpanels
methods.description: Retrieves available subpanels for a specified module.

methods.name: saveSubPanelDefOverride
methods.description: Saves layout overrides for a subpanel, including custom definitions.

methods.name: get_subpanel_setup
methods.description: Returns the subpanel setup configuration for a module from layout defs.

methods.name: getSubPanelDefine
methods.description: Retrieves combined default and custom subpanel definitions for a module.

methods.name: _get_custom_subpanel_define
methods.description: Helper to retrieve custom subpanel definitions from layout defs.

methods.name: _get_default_subpanel_define
methods.description: Helper to retrieve default subpanel definitions from layout defs.

methods.name: buildSearchQuery
methods.description: Constructs the search query based on search form input.

methods.name: get_searchdefs
methods.description: Retrieves search definitions for a module.

methods.name: getSearchForm
methods.description: Creates and returns the HTML for the subpanel search form.
